completeOriginalProcedureUnchanged: KEEP Action,60feet and one faction's next SEVEN DAYS. NEW choose one willing perceived recipient within60feet and line of effect, including self, to receive the private forecast; this explicitly assigns the range to the local recipient rather than restricting an entire institution to a60-foot bubble. Choose one exact known canonical factionId and one concrete institutional question about its activity/outcome over the604800elapsed seconds immediately following resolution. No current representative,membership,positive standing or headquarters proximity is required, following the reviewed institutional-inquiry model. The forecast can concern a remote institution, a NEW explicit scope choice rather than unspoken universal sensing. No roll. The Director provides up to three materially relevant most-likely developments answering that one question, ordered chronologically within the seven-day horizon. Each gives one concrete likely institutional action/outcome and a bounded time window no finer than one day, plus at most one material condition that could change that development. These are useful predictions, not merely current public descriptions. Use established actual institutional plans,capabilities,pressures and current individual choices where relevant; hidden unprotected premises may inform a forecast without becoming a separate roster or transcript. Where a development is not supportably predictable because required facts are missing/protected or alternatives materially coequal, report Indeterminate for that portion; uncertainty/free will alone is not grounds to conceal an otherwise supported likely outcome. A genuine established expectation of no material development may be stated as such, distinct from unknown. Choose at most three stable most-material developments if more are responsive; record that selection under the actual state so rephrasing/caster changes do not rotate hidden plans. Do not separately reveal exact agents,locations,private motives,resources,die results or a guaranteed victorious strategy except an unprotected subject essential to describing the permitted institutional outcome. One leader's protected thought remains protected and cannot be recategorized to bypass it; independently established institutional circumstances can still support a forecast. Every statement is conditional on current premises and normal future uncertainty, not destiny or compulsion. Later choices,events and dice may change reality without making the earlier forecast dishonest. Equivalent inquiries under materially unchanged circumstances repeat the same overlapping-horizon forecast; shifting the clock a trivial amount does not reveal a new coequal selection. Genuinely new relevant facts,different concrete questions or a materially different portion of the seven-day window permit a new actual paid inquiry. No daily cap or free repeat is added. Only the designated recipient receives the result unless they share it through actual communication. No reputation change,faction creation,new member list,assignment of morality or cosmological foreknowledge follows.
